No claim of Linux/Windows/current-main maintainer acceptance.

baseline_compare.policy: The overlay may retain or reduce target-baseline failures but must introduce no new failed/error node IDs.

Residual at-most-once loss window after durable claim and before observed send.
Public generic channel_reply and descendant-discovery product boundaries remain HOLD.
purpose: Fixed, repeatable local replay of the default-off Telegram Agent-switching experiment across upstream upgrades.

recorded_current_main_evidence.nonpackage_governance: 267 passed plus four exact-base inherited failures reproduced identically
recorded_current_main_evidence.static: diff-check, AST, regular-file, newline, conflict-marker, private-path/key, untracked and ignored-residue clean

upgrade_policy.conflict: Stop. Adapt only in a new version-specific commit and update this manifest with new target SHA, new commit/tree/patch IDs, tests, wheels and rollback receipt.
upgrade_policy.exact_parent: Replay must reproduce the authoritative feature tree exactly.
upgrade_policy.later_upstream: Three-way replay must apply cleanly; all must-pass groups and the baseline-delta governance gate must pass before a wheel is considered usable.
upgrade_policy.shallow_clone: Fetch enough upstream history to contain the prerequisite parent before importing the bundle.
